items.text: Arrive a few minutes early and look for the FAITH KIDZ check-in.
Our team will walk you and your child to the right classroom.
After the service, pick your child up from the same room.
Every child is checked in and checked out by our FAITH KIDZ team.
Rooms are cleaned and prepared before every service.
Our volunteers love kids and are here to care for yours.
We can't wait to meet your family.
